description: Turn a previewed offer draft into the numbered Angebot, Kostenvoranschlag or Auftragsbestätigung. Only call it after the user has seen the preview and explicitly said yes. review_hash comes from the last preview_offer result; a stale hash is refused. Fails with the missing fields when something mandatory is missing. Calling it again for the same draft returns the document already created.

review_hash.description: review_hash of the preview the user confirmed
